title: New closed tube loop mediated isothermal amplification assay for prevention of product cross-contamination
author: Karthik, Rathore, et al.

steps.title: Prepare agar dye capsule
steps.instruction: Make a 1.5% agar solution using Hi Media agar and autoclaved distilled water, let it cool; cut the barrel tip of a 1 mL intradermal syringe to expose the plunger tip; load 20 µL molten agar into the syringe through the cut site so it overlays the plunger tip and allow it to solidify for 1–2 min; pipette 2 µL SYBR Green I onto the solid agar; add a second layer of 20 µL molten agar over the SYBR Green and let it solidify.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.5% agar (Hi Media, India) with autoclaved distilled water and allow to cool.
Cut the barrel tip of a 1 mL intradermal syringe to expose the plunger tip.
Load 20 µL molten agar into the syringe through the cut site, overlay the plunger tip, and solidify for 1–2 min.
Add 2 µL SYBR Green I onto the solid agar layer.
Add another 20 µL molten agar over the SYBR Green and allow to solidify.

steps.title: Prepare LAMP reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the LAMP reaction mixture in PCR tubes according to the assay design (as described earlier).

steps.title: Insert capsule into PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Plunge the agar dye capsule into each PCR tube containing the LAMP mixture, positioning it so that it does not touch the tube cap nor the reaction mixture.

steps.title: Run LAMP and inactivate
steps.instruction: Carry out the LAMP amplification at the optimized temperature; after amplification, inactivate the reaction by heating at 95 °C for 5 min (agar melts easily at this temperature).

description: The present work was designed to develop a closed tube LAMP assay using agar dye capsule using SYBR green dye I, having good sensitivity and also the use of Light Emitting Diode (LED) bulbs to fluoresce dye instead of UV light. LAMP assay for detection of Brucella spp. was designed using this modified closed tube method combined with LED technique for result visualization.
